camel_example: aliyun cloudfw ModifySlsDispatchStatus --region cn-hangzhou --Site cn --NewRegionId 'cn-shanghai' --EnableStatus true --FilterKeys 'attack,acl' --DispatchValue internet_log
description_en: Modifies the log delivery settings for Simple Log Service (SLS)
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw modify-sls-dispatch-status --enable-status true --dispatch-value internet_log --filter-keys attack,acl --new-region-id cn-shanghai --site cn --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySlsDispatchStatus

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to deliver logs. A value of \`true\` enables delivery, and \`false\` disables it
parameters.help_zh: 是否投递： true:有效，false:不投递
parameters.name: enable_status

parameters.help_en:
The key for the log category. Valid values:

internet_log

vpc_firewall_log

nat_firewall_log

ipv6_firewall_log

dns_firewall_log
parameters.help_zh:
分类日志的key。取值：

internet_log

vpc_firewall_log

nat_firewall_log

ipv6_firewall_log

dns_firewall_log
parameters.name: dispatch_value

parameters.help_en:
The supported filter conditions. Valid values:

attack

acl

other
parameters.help_zh:
支持的过滤条件。取值：

attack

acl

other
parameters.name: filter_keys

parameters.help_en: The site to modify. If the log version is 1, leave this parameter empty or set it to \`global\`. If the log version is 2, set this parameter to \`cn\` or \`intl\`
parameters.help_zh: 这个字段用来指示修改哪个站点，如果日志版本为1，这个字段可以不填，或者global,如果日志版本为2，这个字段必须填，cn或者intl
parameters.name: site
